rationale.conceptual: Fitting four explicitly defined regression models (linear and exponential) using a common library (scipy.optimize.curve_fit) is a standard method with minor variations, well within the second anchor.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has two sequential steps (fit models and output predictions, then compute delta) using standard libraries only, with straightforward CSV/JSON I/O.

difficulty.reasoning: The task is a straightforward regression fitting exercise on a tiny dataset (16 alloys) using standard least-squares solvers. No novel algorithm or deep domain knowledge is required; simply applying off-the-shelf curve fitting. The pipeline consists of two simple steps with no complex orchestration.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Only 16 data points; regression fitting is CPU-only and uses negligible memory and data. Total dataset size is a few hundred bytes.
